head: YouTube mute button on mobile: one tap above the progress bar
dek: YouTube's phone app is getting its own mute button, placed just above a video's progress bar, so one tap turns the sound off or on. It's rolling out in stages, and some users say they hit it by accident.
details: Before, the player had no mute control, so people used their phone's volume buttons. Android Authority's writer had the button on iPhone but not on Android. A Reddit post suggests testing began in early October; one user saw it on only one of three Pixel phones running the same YouTube version, 21.46.522, which points to a rollout switched on by YouTube's servers. Some users say the video mutes when they try to skip forward; YouTube hasn't commented.
where: YouTube app on iPhone and Android, rolling out in stages
means: If your videos suddenly go quiet when you tap near the bottom of the player, the new mute button may be the reason.
todo: Look for the speaker icon just above the progress bar and tap it again to bring the sound back. Nothing to do if you don't have it yet.
